journey.4_queued: req.status queued, portal status preparing, can_launch false
journey.5_worker_claims: claim_next_demo_clone_job with worker_id e16-worker-* succeeds, second claim None, real worker None
journey.6_clone: execute_demo_clone_job with real adapters (patched _find_template_filestore to synthetic src) → dst DB mosh_demo_*, filestore /tmp/.demo_clone_*, role mosh_demo_r_*, demo_login demo_*, chk_validation 2 rows copied

journey.10_restricted_user: res_users login demo_* exists, active true, share false, not in Administration/Settings/Technical, rolcreatedb false
journey.11_no_second_clone: repeat checkout idempotent, repeat execute returns same tenant_code/db_name, pg_database count with prefix <=3
journey.12_cleanup: rollback_demo_clone + _cleanup_synthetic → src/dst DBs and filestores removed, baseline counts restored
